skill.summary: 自动登录微信公众号，自动填写标题正文，生成并设置AI封面图，支持草稿保存、摘要留言赞赏配置，提升发布效率。

latestVersion.changelog:
Decleormx WeChat Official Account publishing tool v1.0.0

- Initial release: Automates article publication, including AI-generated images for cover and body insertion.
- Supports one-time login via QR and automatic login with cookies after first use.
- AI image generation creates 4 pictures per post, picks the best, and falls back to an image library on failure.
- Flexible article parameters: custom prompts, abstract, comment/discussion and reward settings, content from file, manual cover, draft vs. direct publish.
- Automated troubleshooting (screenshots, error handling) and clear cookie/session management included.
